scope: Compare ACadSharp issue #1261's reported GEODATA R2009/Civil-tail failure with libdxfrw's ODA-bound target-version codec and focused generated controls.

externalReport.title: DWG writer: GeoData version R2009 omits the trailing Civil-3D data block — AutoCAD fails to open (eFilerError)
externalReport.observation: The report describes two non-shareable drawings whose GEODATA object class version is R2009 (version 1), with a fixed Civil 3D block following mesh faces. The reported block ends with CoordinateProjectionRadius. It says AutoCAD 2023 rejects the resaved output while ZWCAD 2026 opens it.
limitations: The report does not give the target DWG revision of either input or output.
The original DWGs and generated failing output are not available for independent inspection.
Peer behavior is not normative format evidence.

formatAuthority.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
formatAuthority.finding: The CIVIL tail is selected by target DWG release (R21 and earlier, with the stated AutoCAD 2010 exception); GEODATA object versions 1, 2, and 3 select separate main-body layouts. The ACadSharp report's class-version-1 finding does not establish a later-target tail rule.

currentImplementation.behavior: hasGeoDataCivilTail selects AC1021 and AC1024 target files independently of GEODATA object version. Both parser and writer preserve the complete bounded tail after mesh points/faces; no-tail targets reject unrepresented CIVIL data.
currentImplementation.coverage: Literal generated body controls cover AC1021 v1, AC1024 v1/v2 and no-tail AC1027 v1/v2/v3 plus AC1032 v2; checks include exact field order, following handle positioning, truncation reset/retry, and no detached-string/handle-stream shift.

disposition: No production-code change is indicated by this report: the known AC1021 R2009 object profile is already covered, while the report omits the target DWG revision needed to challenge the normative release gate. Keep physical producer, native AutoCAD/ZWCAD, and composed whole-document GEODATA qualification open; do not broaden the tail to AC1027/AC1032 from class version alone.
next: Obtain an eligible physical source with identified target revision and source/output bytes, or independent authoritative clarification for the later-target case; until then retain the current target-version gate and atomic refusal behavior.
